title: 2020 HMMT February Guts Problem 3
statement: Let \(A B C\) be a triangle and \(D, E\), and \(F\) be the midpoints of sides \(B C, C A\), and \(A B\) respectively. What is the maximum number of circles which pass through at least 3 of these 6 points?

solutions.text: All \(\binom{6}{3}=20\) triples of points can produce distinct circles aside from the case where the three points are collinear \((B D C, C E A, A F B)\).
